headline: Bitstamp Intake Rises To 291.6 Million Dollars As Exchange Inflow Climbs To 456.1 Million
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues rose to a 456.1 million dollar net inflow, 0.1687 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, from a 186.0 million dollar net inflow at 0.0688 percent. Bitstamp took in 291.6 million dollars, up from 120.1 million, and Bybit took in 131.6 million dollars, up from 99.1 million, while OKX flipped from a 61.1 million dollar outflow to a 39.1 million dollar inflow and Bitfinex shed 89.5 million dollars after a 1.8 million dollar outflow. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, so a positive print means dollars arrived where holders can sell and a negative print means dollars left those venues.
author: jordan
